get_supported_openai_params: get the list of supported OpenAI image variation parameters for a given model
map_openai_params: merge non-default params into optional params dict for an OpenAI image variation call
transform_request_image_variation: transform image variation request fields with image data and optional params into HttpHandlerRequestFields
transform_response_image_variation: transform a synchronous HTTP response into an ImageResponse for OpenAI image variation
get_error_class: return the appropriate OpenAI error class given an error message, status code, and response headers
